name: Rot Fly

bonuses.name: Buzzing Flight
bonuses.text: Rot Flies usually move by Flying. If knocked prone, they may choose to hover above the ground instead of landing.

abilities.name: Frightful Form
abilities.text: Anyone that can see this threat must make a DN 4 Fear Test.

determination: Daemonic Determination: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 7d6. Daemons can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds. Any Wounds negated by Determination are ignored instead of being converted to Shock.
note: Reprint of darktide-rot-flies; differs in Shock (printed '-', Darktide 3), keywords (NURGLE, not MARK OF NURGLE) and Tier row (same letters, A E T T T). Speed printed '10(Flying)'. Foul Mouthparts prints no range, so it is stored with range [1].
